app_store.name: FolioHaven: Ebook Reader
app_store.subtitle: Serene Bookshelf & Notes
app_store.promotional_text: Read EPUB, PDF, MOBI, and comic files in a calm, modern reader with full annotations, custom shelves, and HTML study export.
app_store.description:
FolioHaven is a serene, modern desktop ebook reader built for readers and researchers who value focus and typography.

Enjoy an elegant digital bookshelf and an uninterrupted reading experience across all major document formats.

Key Capabilities:
- Broad Format Compatibility: Open reflowable EPUB, high-resolution PDF, MOBI, FB2, CBZ comics, and TXT files seamlessly.
- Thoughtful Study Tools: Annotate with four harmonious color swatches, write inline commentary, and export complete study notes directly to clean HTML.
- Calm Reading Canvas: Dual-column book spreads, distraction-free fullscreen, and four custom reading palettes (Day, Night, Sepia, Dark Sepia).
- Unrestricted Organization: Build custom shelves, filter by format or progress, and search your entire library instantly.
- Private & Offline: Your reading data, highlights, and library stay entirely on your local machine with open SQLite storage.

Designed for book lovers who cherish quiet reading.

google_play.title: FolioHaven: Ebook Reader
google_play.short_description: Calm, focused digital reading with clean typography and study notes.
google_play.full_description:
FolioHaven is a serene, modern desktop ebook reader designed for book lovers, students, and researchers.

Immerse yourself in literature without interruptions. FolioHaven pairs a clean digital bookshelf with an advanced reflow reading engine.

Core Features:
- Multi-Format Support: Seamlessly read EPUB, PDF, MOBI, FB2, CBZ, and TXT documents.
- Study Notes & Annotations: Highlight text across four soft color swatches, attach personal commentary, and export your research to clean HTML.
- Ergonomic Reading Canvas: Enjoy comfortable two-column spreads, smooth zoom controls, and custom themes including Day, Night, Sepia, and Dark Sepia.
- Complete Library Freedom: Organize your collection into custom shelves, sort by reading progress, and search titles instantly.
- Privacy First: 100% offline local storage with open SQLite database portability.

Experience calm, uninterrupted reading with FolioHaven.
